# Cistus × aguilari O.E.Warb.

First published in J. Roy. Hort. Soc. 56: 222 (1931)

This hybrid is accepted

The native range of this hybrid is W. Medit. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome. The hybrid formula is C. ladanifer subsp. mauritianus × C. populifolius subsp. major.
